title: Travel: Paul McCartney – Barbados to New York City | 1970
content:
Paul and Linda McCartney flew from Barbados to New York City on 4 December 1970.

They had been there since 21 November, following the completion of the backing tracks for Ram, although overdubs were still needed.

They had stayed at the five star Sandy Lane resort, close to Holetown and Paynes Bay on Barbados.
